text:
liam: FYI the sample Next edge middleware shows a big regression after SDK 1.8.0 landed. page payload +140KB and failed in Cloudflare with 'ReferenceError: process is not defined'.

neha: ouch. which import did you use?

liam: `import SDK from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` in /middleware.ts. bundle analyzer shows node shims (process, buffer, crypto) pulled in and a huge lodash chunk.

riley: default import hits the CJS compatibility glue if package's root re-exports cjs. bundlers often treat that as CommonJS and include everything.

liam: I inspected node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/package.json in the app: has "main" and "module" fields but no "exports" and no "sideEffects". there is an index.js that does `module.exports = require('./dist/index.cjs.js')`.

neha: That exact pattern prevents tree-shaking. Workaround for apps is to import explicit ESM entry: `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js'` or pin 1.7.x. But both are garbage UX.

riley: quick repro with esbuild: `esbuild --bundle middleware.ts --platform=browser` and you'll see `require('crypto')` and `process` shim added. The auth signing helper does a sync `require('crypto')` at top-level which triggers shim inclusion.

liam: Cloudflare stacktrace points at `dist/shims/crypto.js`, then process is used by some old utils.

ci-bot: :warning: bundle-regression detected for sample-edge (delta +140KB). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/bundles/1768601010.html

neha: For the SDK team we should: 1) add an exports map so `import '@redwood-inference/sdk'` maps to ESM dist by default for ESM-aware bundlers, and keep CJS for require consumers; 2) set "sideEffects": false in package.json (with exceptions if necessary); 3) move any `require('node:crypto')` or `require('fs')` out of top-level into lazy code paths; 4) ensure published tarball doesn't include dev artifacts or accidental shims.

riley: also run compatibility smoke tests in CI: bundle with esbuild, rollup, webpack targeting edge/browser, confirm no node shims added. add a small script that checks for string "process" or "Buffer" in the final bundle or checks for 'node-libs-browser' entries.

liam: typings note: if we change exports and make default import point to ESM, TS consumers using `import SDK from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` may require `esModuleInterop` fallback. We should provide proper default export shape in .d.ts or add an `index.d.ts` that re-exports default correctly. Also set "types" in package.json.

neha: temporary customer-facing guidance: add note in changelog + README telling edge/worker/Deno users to import `@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js` until we ship a fix. I'll draft the changelog blurb.

riley: small remediation PR ideas: - change index.js root to `export * from './dist/index.esm.js'` for ESM-aware packagers (but needs CJS fallback) - better: add conditional exports map: {"import":"./dist/index.esm.js","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js"} - add "sideEffects": false - fix top-level requires

liam: I'll open a minimal repro with Next + Cloudflare worker and link the analyzer. target branch sdk/1.8.x.

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Repro artifact uploaded to issue tracker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/479/artifacts

neha: Add a docs section (docs/devex/edge-worker.md) explaining common bundler pitfalls and recommended import lines, plus a snippet for Next middleware: ````ts
// recommended (tmp until SDK patch)
import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RI_KEY })
````

riley: Also double-check published package contents: sometimes rollup outputs both cjs and esm files but a root index.js accidentally `require('./dist/index.cjs')` which defeats tree-shaking. Ensure the package entrypoints are minimal.

liam: I'll add CI job to fail if any edge sample increases >50KB. assigning to @sdk-release for the fix.

neha: Thanks, everyone. I'll file the issue with the analyzer HTML, the reproduction steps, and a suggested patch for exports map + sideEffects. Also will add the docs blurb and the temporary changelog note.

riley: ping me on the PR; I can validate with rollup + webpack locally.

docs-bot: :memo: Created draft docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/102 - edge bundler guidance.
